title: Design: A/P Unpaid Invoices chevron button, tooltips and pinned group row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the report has open documents in several vendor groups on today's date, one with more lines than fit on the screen.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with every group collapsed.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Look at each vendor group row's own chevron.
  3. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
  4. Click it.
  5. Hover over it again.
  6. Scroll down through the tallest vendor group.
  7. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  8. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One chevron button, the design system's chevron icon, in blue, in the top-left header cell, pointing right (every group collapsed).

Step 2:

  • Every vendor group row shows the same chevron in the same blue as the header chevron, pointing right when closed.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip above the button reads "Expand all", letter for letter.

Step 4:

  • Every vendor group opens and its chevron points down.

Step 5:

  • The tooltip above the button reads "Collapse all".

Step 6:

  • The vendor group's row stays pinned just under the column headings, with its label visible at the left.

Step 7:

  • The page switches to dark theme.
  • The pinned row is readable.

Step 8:

  • The tooltip sits above the button and is readable in dark theme.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group. The chevron is blue, the same as each group's own chevron (S4-R5).”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

Partly checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026; not yet seen on that build: the header chevron's blue colour (added 14 Nov 2026 for PRD version 13).

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). The design shows the chevrons and the pinned vendor row; the tooltip is not drawn.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p3-same-on-a-p-unpaid-invoices.png: figure "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-unpaid-invoices-at-1440-every-column-visible.png: figure "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-collection-date-and-customer-only.png: figure "A/R Collection, groups opened one by one" (Production (before)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Vendor rows pin the same way; re-sorting never collapses an open group. S4-R6, S2-R9." (caption of "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices")
  • "At 1440 pixels every column fits without sideways scrolling: Date, Location, Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount and the pinned, bold Open Balance. Group labels span to the total; text columns wrap. S8-R3." (caption of "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible")
  • "Each customer opens with its own arrow; there is no way to open or close them all." (caption of "A/R Collection, groups opened one by one")

Difference from the PRD (DD-08), closed: PRD version 12 (12 Nov 2026) says the header chevron "is blue, the same as each group's own chevron (S4-R5)" (S4-R1); the design shows the top-left header chevron in dark grey beside the blue group chevrons (for example in "Expand all from the header", "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices", "Open Balance pinned, light" and "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible"). Closed by the later PRD ruling: PRD version 12 (12 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic) added the chevron's colour to S4-R1 after these pictures were taken, and version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward, the design authority) keeps it. Compare the layout with the pictures; the header chevron's colour comes from the PRD.
